VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a specific technical concern about the invalidation logic on partial writes that contradicts the agent's claim of complete invalidation coverage. While the agent reports all 96 tests passing, the reviewer's observation about a potential gap in the update path—even with the caveat of not having verified it—identifies a plausible failure mode that undermines confidence in the solution. The acceptance criteria requires that "stale quotes are no longer served," and a partial write bypass would violate this. The self-report alone cannot override this credible technical concern from a witness reviewer.
